    AI Overview
    No, Justin Rose has never won the Masters Tournament. Despite a stellar record at Augusta National, he has finished as a runner-up three times (2013, 2017, and a playoff loss to Rory McIlroy in 2025). He is noted for having held or shared the first-round lead multiple times but has yet to secure the green jacket. 
    Key Masters Near-Misses: 
    • 2025: Lost in a playoff to Rory McIlroy.
    • 2017: Tied for first after 72 holes, lost in a playoff to Sergio Garcia.
    • 2015: Finished tied for second, four strokes behind Jordan Spieth. 
    While he has not won the Masters, Rose is a major champion, having won the 2013 U.S. Open.

    Over the last decade or so no one has come closer to winning a Masters without donning the green jacket than Justin Rose. He’s finished 2nd on 3 different occasions, being beaten by Jordan Spieth’s record breaking performance in 2015, then in a playoff by Sergio Garcia in 2017, and finally last year to Rory McIlroy’s spectacular playoff birdie. He spoke about how he deals with adversity ahead of this year’s tournament: “I kind of realized that even before I won a major. I knew I was going to win some; I knew I was going to lose some. I kind of wanted to not get in my way too early, and I kind of realized when the opportunity presents myself to win a major, don’t make it too important in the moment. “Also, I kind of realized that you can’t skip through a career without a little bit of heartache and heartbreak, no chance.
